Source: A 17-year-old boy presents to the emergency department after a car accident.
He drove his car into a pole while speeding at night.
He is complaining of a headache.
Physical exam reveals a confused young man.
He knows his name and address and is able to remember other information about himself.
Throughout the exam, he continuously asks what happened to him.
He has no past medical history and takes no medications.
The patient is unable to offer a history and repetitively asks the nurses what happened.
Cranial nerves 2-12 are intact and the patient has normal strength and sensation.
His temperature is 97.6°F (36.4°C), blood pressure is 122/74 mmHg, pulse is 90/min, respirations are 12/min, and oxygen saturation is 98% of room air.
